d: Get wind of a spirit’s last question and revisit a ghost’s grim final moments.

Witness a dream home turn into a nightmare for one woman when she’s attacked by ghosts. Meanwhile, a man who’s left at home to finish some long-overdue projects notices a mysterious black mist that eventually renders him immobile.
Discover a sinister intruder; learn how a long-dead soldier saves a life.
Examine evidence of a satanic sacrifice and pursue a bloodthirsty ghost doctor.

st: Rest in Peace - Please/Psych Ward Spirit
d: Grapple with a tormented soul and face a deserted hospital’s resident demon.

st: Whispers In The Dark/Board At Work
d: Explore a haunted hospital; witness a spirit be summoned with a Ouija board.

st: Basement Dweller/Do Not Resuscitate/Children of Barn
d: Track lost souls in a nursing home and meet ghosts haunting a childhood pal.

See what happens when a mother and daughter spend the last night of their trip to Ireland in a castle. Meanwhile, eight-year-old Greg heads to his kitchen to investigate a mysterious sound, which sets the stage for a series of terrifying events.
Look at scars left by a prisoner’s ghost and examine a haunted nursing home.

st: Mannequin Mayhem/The Voice/Someone To Watch Over Me
d: Join an EMT who has the fright of her life; meet a scary spirit at a crash site.
Accompany an officer into a possessed home; visit a supernatural amusement park.
Study a campus cop’s escape from a satanic ritual and meet a clingy phantom.

st: No Place for a Child + Little Ghost Girl
d: Meet a 10-year-old boy who’s attacked by a spirit and left with the sign of the devil. Then witness a series of strange and unsettling events that take place when a woman is looking after her three-year-old niece in her new home.
Help a tortured soul find peace with a rookie EMT and face a fiery apparition.
Hitch a ride with a spirit to a firefighter’s home; attend a ghoulish wedding.

st: Kevin Help Us + Ghostman and Robin
d: See what happens after Robin’s daughter leaves for the evening and Robin hears voices coming from the living room. Meanwhile, Pauline and her younger daughter notice evidence of their deceased cat Kevin when they move into a new apartment.
Hear about a woman who gets a good deal on an apartment but quickly finds out it was too good to be true. Then meet a young man who’s attacked by a spider-like demon when he’s left home alone.
Watch a child haunt an officer; meet the spirit behind a series of accidents.
Search for a jailhouse apparition and visit a firehouse plagued by poltergeists.
